killedBy: hud: the pause exit is contextual (issue #323) offers Change Setup at Pause in a versus match, and on no other panel (issue #261)
why: Shows Change Setup on every panel: the Main Menu, both campaign end screens, a paused campaign round. Two different wrongs at once -- a campaign session has no versus setup to change, and the versus END screen already carries its own route to the pane (issue #279's set), so a second one puts two on one panel. The test drives both axes for that reason: wrong kind and wrong surface are separate mistakes and a gate keyed on only one of them survives the other. Re-anchored for issue #279, which gave the button a SECOND surface (the versus ending) -- the gate is now a disjunction, and showing it everywhere still means offering a versus configuration pane to campaign and practice sessions.
